Wearable Medical Devices for Chronic Condition Management - MedTech Engine: 1 month ago - For decades, both required a clinical setting — scheduled appointments, lab draws, and reactive adjustments after symptoms had already escalated. Wearable medical devices are changing that equation. Continuous glucose monitors, cardiac patches, remote blood pressure cuffs, and implantable-adjacent sensors are moving real-time physiological data from hospital corridors into patients’ daily lives.
